DurableWorkIdentity.invariant: Identity is immutable; attempt/process/client identifiers are never substituted for work_unit_id.

RegisterDurableWorkIdentity.failure: Same identity/different intent -> reject and alert.

OpenRecovery.failure: Concurrent open -> one epoch wins; loser reloads.

TransitionRecovery.failure: Stale/illegal transition -> reject without side effect.

GetRecoveryStatus.consistency: Projection with version/freshness; authority remains RecoveryRegistry/domain state.
GetRecoveryStatus.failure: Return explicit unavailable/stale/partial metadata; never fabricate authoritative state.

transaction_rules: RecoveryRecord mutations use expected-version CAS/optimistic concurrency.
Local RecoveryRecord/RecoveryEvent updates commit in one durable journal frame.
Serialization/deadlock retries repeat only the safe local transaction and never an external effect.
